passages.provision_quote: The Secretary of the California Health and Human Services Agency shall research, develop, and pursue discussions of a waiver framework in consultation with the federal government with the objective of creating a health care system that incorporates the following features and objectives:
passages.note: Operative section directs a waiver study, not an enactment of coverage; it states the objective it seeks per H16.

rows.reasoning: SB 770 (2023-2024), which Wiener authored and voted Aye on, directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to pursue a federal waiver 'with the objective of creating a health care system that incorporates' comprehensive benefits and no cost sharing, and declares that 'the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system.' Under H16, a study directive that states its sought outcome shows only the pro-public-financing side, not a specific rung; the operative text orders research and reports, not an enacted coverage system matching any one rung's clauses.
